  );
  Publish-Catalog 'insurance_providers' $p.tenant $p.company 'Insurance Providers' 'compliance' @(

    @{code='bao_viet';label='Bao Viet';status='active'}
  );
  Publish-Catalog 'contract_types' $p.tenant $p.company 'Contract Types' 'hr-policy' @(

  );
  Publish-Catalog 'legal_entities' $p.tenant $p.company 'Legal Entities' 'organization' @(

const helper = `
def mapGradleSubstPath(String p) {
  if (p == null) return p
  def realRoot = System.getenv('GRADLE_REAL_REPO_ROOT')
  def substRoot = System.getenv('GRADLE_SUBST_REPO_ROOT')
  if (realRoot == null || substRoot == null) return p

  def idx = p.toLowerCase().indexOf(marker.toLowerCase())
  if (idx < 0) return p
  def rel = p.substring(idx + marker.length())
  if (rel.startsWith(File.separator)) rel = rel.substring(File.separator.length())
  else if (rel.startsWith('/')) rel = rel.substring(1)
  return new File(substRoot, rel).absolutePath
}
`;

}

  'project(\":\${moduleProject.name}\").projectDir = new File(mapGradleSubstPath(moduleProject.sourceDir))'
);

  'includeBuild(new File(modulePlugin.sourceDir))',
  'includeBuild(new File(mapGradleSubstPath(modulePlugin.sourceDir)))'
);
fs.writeFileSync(g,t);

  sed -i 's/^XBOS_FE_PORT=.*/XBOS_FE_PORT=5173/' deploy/xevn-ecosystem/.env

const fs=require('fs');
const text=fs.readFileSync('docs/ecosystem/PHASE1_UC_SRS_TECHSPEC_MATRIX.md','utf8');
const lines=text.split('\n');
const hrm=[];
for(const line of lines){
  const m=line.match(/\|\s*(\d+)\s*\|\s*`([^`]+)`\s*\|[^|]*\|\s*[^|]*\|\s*[^|]*\|\s*[^|]*\|\s*[^|]*\|\s*(data|be|e2e_pass|planned|fe|waived)\s*\|\s*(HRM|Mobile|XBOS\+HRM|FE)\s*\|/);
  if(m) hrm.push({stt:+m[1], uc:m[2], status:m[3], owner:m[4]});
}
const by={};
hrm.forEach(x=>{by[x.status]=(by[x.status]||0)+1});
console.log('Total HRM block:', hrm.length);
console.log('By impl_status:', by);
const groups={};
hrm.forEach(x=>{
  let g='other';
  if(x.uc.startsWith('XBOS-DM-HRM')||x.uc.startsWith('UC-XBOS-CAT')) g='catalog';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('UC-HRM-MOB')) g='mobile';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('UC-HRM-2')) g='embed';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('UC-HRM-')) g='platform';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('HRM-AT')) g='attendance';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('HRM-EM')) g='employees';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('HRM-PR')) g='payroll';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('HRM-RC')) g='recruitment';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('HRM-CI')) g='contracts';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('HRM-SV')||x.uc.startsWith('HRM-OP')) g='operations';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('HRM-MD')) g='metadata';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('HRM-SC')) g='settings';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('HRM-IM')) g='import';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('HRM-PF')) g='performance';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('HRM-NT')) g='notifications';
  else if(x.uc.startsWith('HRM-FL')) g='fleet';
  groups[g]=groups[g]||{};
  groups[g][x.status]=(groups[g][x.status]||0)+1;
});
console.log('\nBy domain:');
Object.entries(groups).sort().forEach(([k,v])=>console.log(k, JSON.stringify(v)));
console.log('\nEmbed UCs:');
hrm.filter(x=>x.uc.match(/^UC-HRM-2/)).forEach(x=>console.log(x.uc, x.status));
console.log('\nMobile UCs sample status:');
hrm.filter(x=>x.uc.startsWith('UC-HRM-MOB')).forEach(x=>console.log(x.uc, x.status));
"`

async function probePersona(id, email, password, kind) {
  let session, headers;
  if (kind === 'mobile') {
    const { body, status } = await mobileLogin(email, password);
    if (!status || status >= 400) return { id, pass: false, login: status };
    const data = body?.data ?? body;
    session = { ...data, access_token: data.access_token ?? data.accessToken };
    headers = authHeaders(session);
  } else {
    session = await portalLogin(email, password);
    headers = { ...authHeaders(session), accept: 'application/json' };
  }

  const company = headers['x-company-id'];
  const paths = [

  ];
  const rows = {};
  for (const [p, k] of paths) {
    const res = await fetch(HRM + p, { headers });
    const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const total = body?.data?.total ?? body?.meta?.total ?? (Array.isArray(body?.data?.data) ? body.data.data.length : 0);
    rows[k] = { http: res.status, code: body?.error?.code ?? body?.code, total: Number(total) || 0 };
  }
  let gmu = null;
  if (kind === 'portal') {
    const g = await fetch(PORTAL + '/api/xbos/tenant-scope/group-member-units', { headers });
    gmu = { http: g.status, code: (await g.json().catch(() => ({})))?.code };
  }
  return { id, email, tenant, company, kind, rows, gmu };
}

  await probePersona('hrbp', 'uat.nv0006@xe.vn', mobilePw, 'mobile'),
];

$base='http://localhost:28001/api/hrm';

function New-ServiceJwt([hashtable]$payload,[string]$secret='xevn-dev-jwt-secret'){
  $header=@{alg='HS256';typ='JWT'};
  $hJson=($header|ConvertTo-Json -Compress);
  $pJson=($payload|ConvertTo-Json -Compress);
  $enc=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8;
  function b64url([byte[]]$bytes){
    [Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes).TrimEnd('=') -replace '\+','-' -replace '/','_'
  }
  $h=b64url($enc.GetBytes($hJson));
  $p=b64url($enc.GetBytes($pJson));
  $data="$h.$p";
  $hmac = New-Object System.Security.Cryptography.HMACSHA256($enc.GetBytes($secret));
  $sigBytes = $hmac.ComputeHash($enc.GetBytes($data));
  $s=b64url($sigBytes);
  return "$data.$s";
}

$now=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds();
$token=New-ServiceJwt @{sub='qa-probe';tenantId='xevn';companyId='main';roleCode='group_ceo';iss='xevn-internal';aud='xevn-api';iat=$now;exp=($now+3600)};
$auth="Bearer $token";

curl.exe -sS "$base" | Out-String | Write-Host;

Write-Host '== list employees (company_id=main) ==';

$empJson = $empResp | ConvertFrom-Json;
$employeeId = $empJson.data.data[0].id;

$today=(Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd');
$end=(Get-Date).AddDays(30).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd');

$contractResp = curl.exe -sS -X POST -H "authorization: $auth" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d $contractBody "$base/contracts-insurance/contracts";
$contractJson = $contractResp | ConvertFrom-Json;
$contractCompany = $contractJson.data.company_id;
Write-Host "contract persisted company_id=$contractCompany";

Write-Host '== create insurance (body.company_id=main) ==';

$reqResp = curl.exe -sS -X POST -H "authorization: $auth" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d $reqBody "$base/recruitment/requisitions";
$reqJson = $reqResp | ConvertFrom-Json;
$reqCompany = $reqJson.data.company_id;

$cycleResp = curl.exe -sS -X POST -H "authorization: $auth" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d $cycleBody "$base/performance/cycles";

Write-Host '== list back to confirm visibility ==';

$requisitionList = curl.exe -sS -H "authorization: $auth" "$base/recruitment/requisitions?company_id=main&page_size=5" | ConvertFrom-Json;
$cycleList = curl.exe -sS -H "authorization: $auth" "$base/performance/cycles?company_id=main&page_size=5" | ConvertFrom-Json;
Write-Host ('contracts list returned=' + $contractsList.data.total);
Write-Host ('requisitions list returned=' + $requisitionList.data.total);
Write-Host ('cycles list returned=' + $cycleList.data.total);

"RESULT|contract_company=$contractCompany|insurance_company=$insCompany|requisition_company=$reqCompany|cycle_company=$cycleCompany|req_title=$reqTitle|cycle_name=$cycleName"`

from pathlib import Path

def parse_env(path):
    m={}
    lines=[]
    p=Path(path)
    if p.exists():
        for raw in p.read_text().splitlines():
            lines.append(raw)
            s=raw.strip()
            if not s or s.startswith('#') or '=' not in raw:
                continue
            k,v=raw.split('=',1)
            m[k]=v
    return m, lines

def upsert(path, updates):
    p=Path(path)
    lines=p.read_text().splitlines() if p.exists() else []
    seen=set()
    out=[]
    for raw in lines:
        if '=' in raw and not raw.strip().startswith('#'):
            k,_=raw.split('=',1)
            if k in updates:
                out.append(f"{k}={updates[k]}")
                seen.add(k)
                continue
        out.append(raw)
    for k,v in updates.items():
        if k not in seen:
            out.append(f"{k}={v}")
    p.write_text('\n'.join(out)+'\n')

xbos,_ = parse_env('apps/api/xbos-api/.env')
deploy,_ = parse_env('deploy/xevn-ecosystem/.env')

issuer = xbos.get('SERVICE_JWT_ISSUER','xevn-internal')
aud = xbos.get('SERVICE_JWT_AUDIENCE','xevn-api')
if not secret:

function Test-Cors {
  param($Method, $Path, $Origin, $Label)
  $uri = "$base$Path"
  try {
    $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri -Method $Method -Headers @{
      "Origin" = $Origin
      "Access-Control-Request-Method" = "GET"
    } -UseBasicParsing -SkipHttpErrorCheck
    $acao = $r.Headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"]
    if ($null -eq $acao) { $acao = "(absent)" }
    [PSCustomObject]@{
      Label = $Label
      Method = $Method
      Path = $Path
      Origin = $Origin
      HTTP = $r.StatusCode
      ACAO = $acao
      Blocked = if ($Origin -eq $evil) { ($acao -eq $null -or $acao -eq "(absent)" -or $acao -eq "null") } else { ($acao -eq $pilot -or $acao -like "*nip.io*") }
    }
  } catch {
    [PSCustomObject]@{
      Label = $Label; Method = $Method; Path = $Path; Origin = $Origin
      HTTP = "ERR"; ACAO = $_.Exception.Message; Blocked = $false
    }
  }
}

$results = @()
# OPTIONS evil
$results += Test-Cors -Method OPTIONS -Path "/api/hrm/" -Origin $evil -Label "OPTIONS hrm evil"
$results += Test-Cors -Method OPTIONS -Path "/api/xbos/" -Origin $evil -Label "OPTIONS xbos evil"

$results += Test-Cors -Method GET -Path "/api/xbos/" -Origin $evil -Label "GET xbos evil"

$results += Test-Cors -Method GET -Path "/api/xbos/" -Origin $pilot -Label "GET xbos pilot"

$results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3`

  param([string]$Xml, [string]$Text)
  $pattern = "text=`"$([regex]::Escape($Text))`"[^>]*bounds=`"\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]`""
  if ($Xml -match $pattern) {

    return $true
  }
  return $false
}
